description: Veriflow Catalog-to-OpenAPI Automation Mapping Index linking production test catalog IDs to contract verification checks.

mappings.name: Happy-path API response schema and contract validation
mappings.description: Validates live HTTP response status code, Content-Type, and body JSON payload against the documented OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 schema contract.
mappings.preconditions: Valid OpenAPI specification exists and target service is running on local loopback.

mappings.name: HTTP 4xx client error presentation and formatting
mappings.description: Validates that submitting invalid payloads or omitting required body/parameters produces HTTP 400 with structured client diagnostics.
mappings.preconditions: Operation documents required parameters or requestBody schema.

mappings.name: Request timeout and client cancellation handling
mappings.description: Validates that contract probes enforce bounded per-request timeouts under network latency.
mappings.preconditions: Target service reachable on local loopback.

mappings.name: Unsupported HTTP methods and route boundaries
mappings.description: Validates that operations restrict execution to documented HTTP methods and reject unsupported verbs with HTTP 405.
mappings.preconditions: Operation documents supported HTTP method list.

mappings.name: Form and input parameter boundary validation
mappings.description: Validates that required path, query, header, or body properties reject empty or boundary-violating inputs.
mappings.preconditions: Operation defines required fields, minLength, maxLength, minimum, or maximum constraints.

mappings.name: Authentication requirement enforcement on protected endpoints
mappings.description: Validates that operations declaring security requirements reject unauthenticated requests with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
mappings.preconditions: Operation defines security requirements in the OpenAPI document.

mappings.name: Service health probe verification
mappings.description: Validates that documented health and readiness probe endpoints (/health, /ready) respond with HTTP 200.
mappings.preconditions: OpenAPI specification documents health probe paths.

mappings.name: Production base URLs and environment parity
mappings.description: Validates documented servers list, ensuring environment URLs conform to valid URI syntax.
